fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Gallops you to a target up to 8 tiles away for a weapon strike that deals 15 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Dust Still Hanging
fusions.desc: Leaves a trail of musk and hoof-dust 7 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. It deals 24 damage, ignoring resistances, to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Upwind at a Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Pace
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
